mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Jousting</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is marked for another round of Jousting.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kled dashes, dealing physical damage and gaining a short burst of speed. Kled can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target, dealing the same damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Kled dashes, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage to enemies he passes through, pulling minions and small monsters towards him.

If this Ability hits an enemy champion or large jungle monster, Kled gains @MoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed for @MoveSpeedDuration@ second(s) and can Recast within @RecastWindow@ seconds to dash back through the same target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: Kled gains True Sight to enemies he passes through.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Jousting</titleLeft><mainText>Kled can dash back through his initial target, dealing the same damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kled can dash back through his initial target, dealing the same damage.

mBuff.mDescription:
Kled rides his trusty steed, Skaarl, who takes damage for him. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts.

While dismounted, Kled's abilities change and he deals less damage to champions. Kled can restore Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies. At maximum courage, Kled remounts with a portion of Skaarl's health.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Mounted: Kled's mount Skaarl takes damage instead of Kled. When his Health depletes, Kled dismounts.

Dismounted: Kled replaces {{spell_KledQ_Name}}, gains @DismountedMS@ Move Speed toward enemy champions, and he gains @DismountedResistBonus@ bonus Armor and Magic Resist, increased by @ResistBonusPerEnemy*100@% for each nearby enemy Champion, up to @DismountedResistBonusMax@. While dismounted, Kled's attacks deal @DismountedAttackPenalty@ reduced damage to Champions.

Kled gains @CourageVsChamps@ Courage by Attacking champions, @CourageVsOther@ Courage by Attacking epic monsters and structures, and @CourageLastHit@ Courage by killing minions. At max Courage Kled remounts with @SkaarlRemountHealth@ of Skaarl's Health, once every @MountCooldown@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_KledPassive_Tooltip}}

Skaarl has @SkaarlHealth@ Health plus 100% of Kled's bonus Health.
When Kled dismounts, he cleanses all crowd control and becomes briefly untargetable.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Frayed Nerves</titleLeft><mainText>Skaarl is afraid and cannot restore courage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Kled throws a bear trap that damages and hooks an enemy champion. If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled.

When dismounted, this ability is replaced by Pocket Pistol, a ranged gun blast that knocks back Kled and restores courage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Mounted: Kled throws a bear trap that deals @TotalDamage@ physical damage and hooks onto the first enemy champion or large jungle monster hit.

If Kled stays near a hooked enemy for @TetherPopTime@ seconds, he yanks out the trap, dealing @TotalYankDamage@ physical damage, Pulling them, and Slowing by @SlowAmount*-100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{spell_KledQ_Tooltip}}

Dismounted: Kled fires a shotgun, dealing @DismountedQDamage@ physical damage and blasting Kled backward. Pellets beyond the first deal reduced damage.

Each pellet that hits an enemy champion or epic monster restores Courage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
While hooked, Kled has True Sight to the enemy.
Deals @MinionDamageMultiplier*100@% damage to minions.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Bear Trap on a Rope</titleLeft><mainText>Kled has hit this target with a bear trap. Flee before he yanks your champion to him and slows you!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Bear Trap on a Rope</titleLeft><mainText>Kled has hit this target with a bear trap. Run away before he yanks you to him and slows you!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kled and Skaarl charge to a location, leaving a speed-granting trail behind them and gaining a shield. Skaarl locks onto and rams the first enemy champion encountered.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Kled charges toward an area, leaving a trail that grants allies increasing <speed>Move Speed</speed>. While charging and for 2 seconds after Kled gains up to <shield>@MaximumShield@ Shield</shield>. Skaarl rams the first enemy champion encountered, dealing <magicDamage>@MinimumDamageTooltip@</magicDamage> to <magicDamage>@MaximumChargeDamage@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> (based on distance travelled) and briefly <status>Knocking Back</status>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: The damage, Move Speed, and Shield reach their max values after @SecondsToMaxPower@ second(s) of charging.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Mr. Kled's Wild Ride</titleLeft><mainText>Allies get a massive speed boost along the direction of the trail.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kled fires a gun blast, hurling him backward. Hitting enemy champions restores <font color='#eae57e'>courage</font>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Dismounted: Kled fires a shotgun, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and blasting Kled backward. Pellets beyond the first deal reduced damage.

Each pellet that hits an enemy champion or epic monster restores Courage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{spell_KledRiderQ_Tooltip}}

Mounted: Kled throws a bear trap that deals @MountedQCalc@ physical damage and hooks onto the first enemy champion or large jungle monster hit.

If Kled stays near a hooked enemy for @spell.KledQ:TetherPopTime@ seconds, he yanks out the trap, dealing @spell.KledQ:TotalYankDamage@ physical damage, Pulling them and Slowing by @spell.KledQ:SlowAmount*-100@% for @spell.KledQ:SlowDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Restore @CouragePerPellet@ Courage per hit against champions, and @CouragePerPellet*0.5@ against epic monsters.
Deals @FalloffPerMissile*100@% damage per hit beyond the first.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Kled gains massive attack speed for four attacks. The fourth attack deals more damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Kled's next Attack grants @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for four Attacks or @ActiveDuration@ seconds.

The fourth hit deals an additional @BaseFlatDamage@ plus @PercentDamage@ max Health physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Max Health damage is capped at @MonsterCap@ physical damage against monsters.
While on Cooldown, Attacks reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @NonChampCooldownRefund@ second(s). Against Champions, this Cooldown reduction is increased to @ChampCooldownRefund@ second(s).

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Violent Tendencies</titleLeft><mainText>Kled gains massive attack speed for four attacks. The fourth attack deals more damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
